runs.title: Moon hides Jupiter tonight: London times
runs.prompt: On the night of Monday 6 October 2026, the Moon will pass in front of (occult) Jupiter. For a viewer in London, UK: what local time does Jupiter disappear behind the Moon, what local time does it reappear, and will the event be visible from London? Give the times and say which source you used.
runs.answer: The Moon does NOT occult Jupiter as seen from London, so there are no local disappearance/reappearance times: the event is not visible from London, UK. Per In-The-Sky.org, the 6 Oct 2026 occultation (occurring 08:14–12:32 UT = 09:14–13:32 BST) is visible only from parts of Africa and the Americas, plus Atlantic islands (Azores, Madeira, Savage Islands, Canary Islands) — no UK/Europe. Astronomy.com, Space & Telescope and When the Curves Line Up agree it's visible only from eastern North America/the Caribbean (pre-dawn) and Africa (daytime); observers outside the path, including London, get only a close Moon–Jupiter conjunction (in daylight on the morning of 6 Oct 2026), with Jupiter never hidden by the Moon. So: visible from London = No; London disappearance/reappearance times = none exist. Source used: In-The-Sky.org (news.php?id=20261006_16_100), corroborated by Astronomy.com and the IOTA UT prediction table.

TheSkyLive occultation page returned a 403 bot-challenge wall.

runs.title: Australia's dengue vaccine: cost and eligibility
runs.prompt: A dengue fever vaccine called Qdenga has just become available in Australia (announced October 2026). Who is it recommended for, what does it cost an Australian patient, and how do Australians actually get it? Use official or authoritative sources and name them.
runs.answer: Qdenga (Takeda's live-attenuated tetravalent dengue vaccine) was registered with the TGA in April 2026 for people aged ≥4 years and became available in Australia in October 2026 via private prescription; it is NOT funded under the National Immunisation Program. ATAGI recommends it for people aged 4 and over with a confirmed or likely history of dengue who are travelling to dengue-endemic areas (and in other specified at-risk groups), given as a 2-dose course at 0 and 3 months, with both doses needed to maximise protection. Because there is no PBS/NIP funding, an Australian patient pays the full private cost (a travel clinic/GP consultation plus the vaccine itself) — I was unable to verify a firm dollar figure from an official source.

runs.title: Seahawks and Joe Mixon: signed or not?
runs.prompt: On 5 October 2026 the Seattle Seahawks were reported to be signing running back Joe Mixon, but on 6 October reports said they reversed course after a physical. What actually happened, and is Joe Mixon now on the Seahawks roster or not? Summarise what the sports news reports say.
runs.answer: Reports say Joe Mixon is NOT on the Seahawks roster (not even the practice squad). On 5 October 2026, PFT's Charean Williams reported Seattle was signing the veteran RB to its practice squad; coach Mike Macdonald confirmed the team worked out Mixon and was "going through the process" of adding him (context: rookie Jadarian Price went on IR and Zach Charbonnet's 21-day return window opened after his playoff ACL tear). On 6 October, PFT's Josh Alper reported Mixon's return was "back on hold": per Adam Schefter of ESPN, the Seahawks "opted not to move forward with the deal after Mixon took a physical," with no word on the specific issue. So the deal collapsed at the physical stage — Mixon missed all of last season with a foot injury and was released by Houston in March, and he remains an unsigned free agent rather than a Seahawk.

runs.title: Missing air ambulance: the Coast Guard's update
runs.prompt: A Canadian air ambulance with six people aboard went missing on a flight near the US East Coast in early October 2026. What has the U.S. Coast Guard said about who was aboard and the current status of the search? Report only official, factual information and name the sources.
runs.answer: The U.S. Coast Guard said six people were aboard the Latitude Air Ambulance Gulfstream G100 jet that went missing on a Bermuda-to-Boston flight early Saturday, Oct 3, 2026: four Canadian crew members — Capt. Philip Gregory Childerhose, first officer Thomas Henry Farquhar, flight nurse Sarah Jane Paton and respiratory therapist Jolene Beth Weir — and two Bermudian nationals, patient Marilyn Lavonne Bean (66) and her son/family escort Sergio Wayne Lottimore (41), who were named by the Bermuda Police Service. On Sunday, Oct 4, the Coast Guard suspended its search after locating a debris field about 20 miles off Nantucket; Rear Adm. Matthew Lake, commander of the Northeast District, said "Suspending a search is not an easy decision... We express our deepest condolences to the families and loved ones affected by the tragedy." At his Sunday briefing Lake said crews had searched about 2,840 square miles over roughly 53 hours and that no black box had been recovered; all six are presumed dead, and the search-and-rescue phase has ended, with Canada's Transportation Safety Board leading the investigation (assisted by the NTSB).
